notes: Use only active price records; exclude the 12 expired records. Retain effective_from for the active record.

tables.reason: The 24 rows are 12 SKUs × 2 price-validity records (active/expired) with price list, net price, tax, and valid-from columns. This is a price-history export, not a unique product master. Operator requirement is to export active prices only and exclude expired records.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header is SKU and values repeat twice per product because the table is price history. Values such as 00470001 contain leading zeros and must be preserved as text.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header and values such as 'SIM replenishment 1' are product names.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Single explicit value THB for all rows.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Single explicit value PCS; matches the sell-unit enum and is not a pack size.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Single explicit value 'standard' for all rows, matching operator instruction to use price_list standard where stated.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Numeric price column with one distinct value per row; header 'Net price' matches price amount synonyms.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Explicit value 'No' on every row means VAT is not included; this is source evidence, not an inference from country or brand.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Explicit 5% fixture value on every row; convert to 0.05 and do not use the schema default 0.07.

columns.name: Valid from
columns.reason: Date values 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-01 identify when each price record starts; operator requires retaining effective_from for the active record.

columns.name: Record state
columns.reason: Values active/expired distinguish price rows, not product lifecycle. Operator requires excluding expired rows, so this column is a filter criterion rather than a product /status mapping.

changes_from_draft: Added a table filter Record state (case-insensitive) = 'active' on the products source so expired price records are excluded per the operator requirement; this yields 12 unique SKUs instead of 24 root rows (which would have duplicated every product).

Removed the /status mapping from 'Record state': active/expired describes price-record validity, not product lifecycle, and would have leaked the non-enum value 'expired' into /status. /status is left to the schema default 'active' (product has a live price); the filtered 'active' flag is still retained via attributes passthrough.
Changed /sku from trim() to cast(trim(SKU), string) to guarantee the zero-padded identifiers '00470001'..'00470012' stay text.
Replaced the constant price_list 'standard' with the source column 'Price list' (explicit value 'standard' in all rows) — same result, but evidenced by the file rather than assumed.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate from 'Tax rate' parsed with percent_to_fraction → 0.05 (explicit fixture value; schema default 0.07 not used).
Changed /prices/*/vat_included from a hard-coded false to parse_bool('Tax included') with a false fallback — the value comes from the explicit 'No' flag in the file.

Added /prices/*/effective_from from 'Valid from' (cast to date), retaining the active record's start date as required; /prices/*/effective_to left unmapped because no end-date column exists and it must not be invented.
Simplified /currency to upper(trim(Currency)) → THB (already ISO 4217); no FX conversion applied.
Collection source role updated to 'pricing' to reflect that history.csv is a price-history export.

No pack size, brand, category, barcode, inventory or promotion columns exist in the file, so those optional targets remain unmapped rather than guessed; the leftover source columns are kept under /attributes.
